'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***At least five people, including three children, are killed and 13 others are injured in an overnight [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] strike on [[Rakitnoye, Belgorod Oblast|Rakitnoye]], [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]], according to Russian officials. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/five-die-in-ukrainian-strike-on-belgorod-as-russian-raid-harms-journalists (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Belarusian involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Ukraine accuses [[Belarus]] of building up a "significant level" of [[Armed Forces of Belarus|troops]] and weaponry, including [[artillery]], [[multiple rocket launcher|multiple-launch rocket systems]] and [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defense systems]] along [[Belarus–Ukraine border|the border]] under the guise of [[military exercise]]s, and demands their immediate withdrawal. [https://kyivindependent.com/belarus-gathering-significant-number-of-troops-weaponry-along-ukraines-border-under-guise-of-exercises-ukraine-says/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-calls-belarus-pull-back-forces-border-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***A [[British people|British]] safety adviser working for [[Reuters]] is killed and two other journalists are injured in a Russian [[ballistic missile]] strike on their hotel in [[Kramatorsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/reuters-staff-hit-strike-hotel-ukraines-kramatorsk-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)] 
**[[Northern Ukraine skirmishes (2022–present)|Northern Ukraine skirmishes]], [[Chernihiv strikes (2022–present)|Chernihiv strikes]]
***At least four people are killed and 37 others are injured in overnight Russian attacks in [[Chernihiv Oblast|Chernihiv]], [[Sumy Oblast|Sumy]], [[Kharkiv Oblast|Kharkiv]], and Donetsk Oblasts, Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attacks-ukraine-with-missiles-drones-ukraine-military-says-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] publicly presents the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]]-produced [[Palianytsia (missile)|Palianytsia]] [[rocket drone]] and [[loitering munition]], intended to serve as the Ukrainian counterpart to the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[ZALA Kub-BLA]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/news/2024/08/25/7471770/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[August 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] says that it has launched [[preemptive war|preemptive strikes]] on [[Hezbollah]] in [[Lebanon]] ahead of an expected major missile and [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Israel]]. [https://www.axios.com/2024/08/25/israel-hezbollah-lebanon-attack (Axios)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-strikes-hezbollah-targets-lebanon-military-says-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)] 
***[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Defence Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] declares an "emergency situation" in Israel for the next 48 hours due to the "special situation in the home front". [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/emergency-situation-declared-in-israel-for-next-48-hours/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 71 people are killed and 112 others are injured in [[Israel]]i attacks in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/at-least-eight-people-killed-in-israeli-air-attack-in-gazas-deir-el-balah (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**[[2024 Barsalogho attack]]
***At least 400 people are killed and over 300 others are injured in a shooting attack by the [[al-Qaeda]]-linked [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] [[Jihadism|jihadist organization]] in [[Barsalogho Department]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-jihadists-kill-hundreds-burkina-faso-attack-2024-08-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Solingen stabbing]]
**[[North Rhine-Westphalia Police|German police]] detain a 26-year-old [[Syrians in Germany|Syrian]] [[asylum seeker]] with ties to the [[Islamic State]] as the suspect of the [[stabbing attack]] in [[Solingen]], [[Germany]], on Friday. The man is [[criminal charge|charged]] with three counts of [[murder in German law|murder]], as well as [[attempted murder]], dangerous bodily harm and membership of a [[terrorist organisation]] abroad. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-knife-attack-solingen-islamic-state-1095235a9dadf6e1005e8adff52d05b4 (AP)]
*Two [[Nigeria Police Force|police officers]] are killed and three others are injured in an attack in [[Abuja]], [[Nigeria]]. A police spokesperson says that the proscribed [[Islamic Movement (Nigeria)|Islamic Movement of Nigeria]] was responsible for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/two-nigerian-police-officers-killed-attack-by-islamist-group-say-police-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Law of Ukraine "On the Protection of the Constitutional Order in the Field of Activities of Religious Organizations"]]
**[[Pope Francis]] condemns the [[Ukrainian government]]'s ban of the [[Moscow]]-linked [[Ukrainian Orthodox Church (Moscow Patriarchate)|Ukrainian Orthodox Church]] and other [[Russia]]-linked religious groups as infringing on [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian civilians]]' [[Civil and political rights|civil right]] to [[Freedom of religion|religious freedom]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/pope-francis-criticizes-push-to-ban-activities-of-russian-affiliated-religious-organizations/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
**At least two people are killed in [[wildfire]]s in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo state]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cze56wn278zo.amp (BBC News)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 20 others are injured in a [[mudslide]] near the [[Phuket Big Buddha|Big Buddha]] in [[Phuket]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/mudslide-thailands-phuket-kills-13-including-2-russians-official-says-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)]
*Twenty-two people are killed when a [[Bus plunge story|bus plunges]] into a [[ravine]] in [[Kahuta Tehsil|Kahuta]], [[Punjab (Pakistan)|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. Separately, twelve people are killed in a bus crash on the [[Makran Coastal Highway]] in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], Pakistan. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/bus-accidents-in-pakistan-leave-dozens-dead-including-pilgrims (Al Jazeera)]
*At least thirteen people are killed and at least 14 others remain missing after a boat carrying [[Ethiopia]]n and [[Yemen]]i migrants from [[Djibouti]] sinks off the coast of [[Taiz Governorate]], Yemen. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/25/at-least-13-killed-14-missing-after-boat-sinks-off-yemen-un-agency (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed, one is injured, two are missing and 21 are rescued unharmed after the collapse of an [[ice cave]] in the [[Breiðamerkurjökull]] [[glacier]], in southern [[Iceland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iceland-ice-cave-collapse-breiamerkurjokull-8d6a45480717589a4699f75f976e3df3 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Four people are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Engadine, New South Wales|Engadine]], [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. The suspect is later taken into custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-police-say-4-people-injured-sydney-stabbing-attack-2024-08-25/ (Reuters)]
